description: Run one saved node on its own, for real, to check its configuration and connection, the way the editor's test button does. It makes the node's actual call to the third-party service, so a 'send' node really sends. With no upstream run, `{{ … }}` expressions are passed through as literal text; the result names any field that affected. To test with real data flowing between nodes, deploy and use run_workflow. Returns the node's raw output.

nodeId.description: The node's id within the saved graph.

workflowId.description: The workflow's id, from list_workflows or create_workflow.
